dpa_missing.label: No data processing agreement
dpa_missing.fix: Link the agreement in the Data processing agreement card, or create one from this contract.

dpa_incomplete.label: DPA incomplete
dpa_incomplete.fix: Sign the agreement and confirm every Art. 28(3) clause in the checklist.

signed_copy_missing.label: No signed copy
signed_copy_missing.fix: Upload the signed copy on the version under Versions and signed copies.

review_overdue.label: Review overdue
review_overdue.fix: Review the contract and record it with "Mark as reviewed".

review_date_missing.label: No review date
review_date_missing.fix: Set the next review date so the supplier is followed up regularly.

notice_soon.label: Notice deadline soon
notice_soon.fix: Decide now whether to renew or give notice, before the deadline passes.

end_date_missing.label: No end date
end_date_missing.fix: Record the end date, or note in the renewal terms that it runs until further notice.

notice_period_missing.label: No notice period
notice_period_missing.fix: Record the notice period so the notice deadline can be worked out.

none.label: No personal data
none.hint: Neither side processes personal data for the other.

they_process.label: They process personal data for us
they_process.hint: The counterparty is our processor (for example a cloud or payroll provider). A data processing agreement is required (GDPR Art. 28).

we_process.label: We process personal data for them
we_process.hint: We are the counterparty’s processor (for example we run a service for a customer). A data processing agreement is required.

joint_controllers.label: Joint controllers
joint_controllers.hint: We decide together why and how the data is processed. You need an arrangement under GDPR Art. 26, not a processor agreement.

transferBases.adequacy: Adequacy decision (e.g. the EU-US Data Privacy Framework)
